title: PrdComposerItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-requirements-prd-composer. This agent COMPOSES prd.md from requirements.md + nfr-spec.md (both already atomic upstream content) plus vision.md (read-only, for Assumptions/Constraints/Risks carry-forward) — same synthesis pattern as L1-vision-statement-generator, applied one level up the pipeline. The mix is deliberate: requirements[] and compound_splits[] stay FULL (statement, full NFR table, source_clause_summary already condensed at the elicitor level) because that content is already atomic and this agent does not re-derive it — dropping so much as one FR statement or NFR boundary condition here would be a composition defect, not a style choice. executive_summary, assumptions[], constraints[], and risks[] are CONDENSED (summary fields capped ~150 chars) because they are genuinely new synthesized narrative — newly phrased prose reconciling vision.md's Regulatory Posture / Open Risks Carried Forward with the concrete FR set — and the full sentences belong ONLY in prd.md, not duplicated here. open_questions[] is condensed too, but only because the source TBD lines and coverage-gap observations are already short. Success metrics are deliberately absent from this schema — vision.md's north_star_metrics remain the single authoritative source (see prd.template.md's own header comment); a metrics field here would be a defect, not an omission.

summary.description: Condensed gloss for orchestration/notification use — the full 3-5 sentence executive summary is written into prd.md, not duplicated here. Must introduce no claim absent from the sections below (same rule as vision.md's own executive summary). Written last.

compound_splits.description: Carried forward verbatim from requirements.md's own compound_splits — not re-derived. Empty array (not omitted) if requirements.md genuinely had none.

assumptions.description: Condensed narrative — full assumption text lives only in prd.md's Assumptions section.

constraints.description: Condensed narrative — full constraint text lives only in prd.md's Constraints section.

risks.description: Condensed narrative — full risk text lives only in prd.md's Risks section. Carried forward from vision.md's Open Risks Carried Forward; a risk newly surfaced by a specific FR is allowed (see prd.template.md's own header comment) but must still be traceable.

requirements.description: One entry per FR in requirements.md — FULL statement and FULL NFR table, carried verbatim, not condensed. Zero FRs may be dropped; zero NFR boundary conditions may be dropped.

open_questions.description: Rollup of every NFR boundary condition still marked TBD across all requirements, plus any requirement-coverage gap noticed while composing FR+NFR side by side. Condensed is fine — the source lines are already short.

short_title.description: Short label matching prd.md's bolded item title — not prose, kept in full

summary.description: Condensed gloss of the assumption/constraint/risk — the full sentence(s) and source citation (e.g. 'vision.md § Regulatory Posture') live only in prd.md

underlies_or_affects.description: Which FR(s) this underlies (assumption), constrains (constraint), or affects (risk). An array of FR ids, or the literal string 'program-level' for a risk/constraint that maps to no single requirement.

boundary_condition.description: Carried verbatim from nfr-spec.md — an explicit number/rule, or literally 'TBD — needs stakeholder input'. Never condensed.

source.description: Carried verbatim from nfr-spec.md's own Source column — a document/KB citation, or '—' if TBD

title.description: Short label matching requirements.md's own FR title — kept in full

statement.description: The full requirement statement, carried verbatim from requirements.md — not re-derived, not condensed.

traces_to.description: Carried verbatim from requirements.md — includes the compound-split parenthetical for a split FR

nfrs.description: Every boundary condition attached to this FR in nfr-spec.md, carried verbatim. May be empty — corresponds to prd.md writing 'No NFR categories apply' for this FR; an empty array here is a deliberate 'none found', not an omission.

reasoning.description: Explains the composition (e.g. which nfr-spec.md categories were attached), not a re-derivation of the requirement itself

fr_id.description: Required when type is 'tbd' — which requirement the TBD boundary condition belongs to

category.description: Required when type is 'tbd' — which NFR category is still open

summary.description: The TBD boundary condition text (already short), or a condensed gloss of the coverage gap noticed while composing — full gap narrative lives only in prd.md

source_clause_summary.description: Carried forward from requirements.md's own compound_splits — already condensed there
